a real photograph of Victor Moses

defaults.video_script: Messi scored in the fourteenth minute against Nigeria, with Argentina needing a win to survive. Argentina had drawn with Iceland and lost three-nil to Croatia. Victor Moses equalised from a penalty in the fifty-first minute. Argentina looked set to go out. Marcos Rojo volleyed in the winner in the eighty-sixth minute. Argentina won two-one and went through to face France. Four days later, France beat them four-three. Was Rojo's volley the most important Argentina goal of that tournament?
defaults.video_subject: Messi scored in the 14th minute against Nigeria at the 2018 World Cup, Victor Moses equalised from a penalty in the 51st, and Marcos Rojo's 86th-minute volley gave Argentina a 2-1 win after a draw with Iceland and a 3-0 loss to Croatia.
